text:
lasers from the big dog

"Charlie Munger drummed in the notion that a person should always 'Do the best that you can do. Never tell a lie. If you say you're going to do it, get it done. Nobody gives a shit about an excuse. Leave for the meeting early. Don't be late, but if you are late, don't bother giving people excuses. Just apologize ... Return your calls quickly. The other thing is the five-second no. You've got to make your mind up. You don't leave people hanging."
